title: Tiling a Rectangle with the Fewest Squares Problem

content.problemStatement:
With a rectangle of size `n` x `m`, output *the smallest number of integer-sided squares that tile the rectangle*.

**Example 1:**

![](https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/10/17/sample_11_1592.png)

```
Input: n = 2, m = 3
Output: 3
Explanation: 3 squares are necessary to cover the rectangle.
2 (squares of 1x1)
1 (square of 2x2)
```

**Example 2:**

![](https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/10/17/sample_22_1592.png)

```
Input: n = 5, m = 8
Output: 5
```

**Example 3:**

![](https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/10/17/sample_33_1592.png)

```
Input: n = 11, m = 13
Output: 6
```

**Constraints:**

* `1 <= n, m <= 13`
